items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I used to go and sing few numbers with Marcelino Guerra because he was unknown for the Spanish people

ctx.x: Yes. Okay, then you - ahh - tell me how the second Afro-Cubans band was formed and why. I got Mario Bauza's version, let me hear your version.

Well, Marcelino is so talented and Mario love talent and he payed respect or tribute or he considers himself obligated to help a person that have talent. Marcelino had the language barrier. He don't want to Marcelino waste all his talent, so Mario says: "Let's organize a band for Marcelino", and he would play the two days that we had off here, the relief band and our own band; so he had two days and then we used to run matinees at the Diplomat, on Sundays, and through my telephone we'll book Marcelino Guerra and…
How long did it take him to become established?
